About the job

Company Introduction

WorldStrides is the global leader in educational travel and experiential learning. The company was founded in 1967 to provide middle school travel programs to Washington, D.C. and has grown to provide a wide range of programs for more than half a million students annually to over 100 countries around the world. WorldStrides offers experiential learning programs in educational travel, performing arts, language immersion, career exploration, service-learning, study abroad, and sports. Each of these experiences helps students to see beyond the classroom and to see the world – and themselves – in new ways.

Job Description

The Business Development Representative (BDR) / Lead Qualifier is responsible for generating new business opportunities through high-volume outbound calls and email outreach to schools and teachers across the U.S.

In this role, you will: Proactively prospect and engage educators to introduce WorldStrides programs, qualify leads by identifying teachers interested in organizing student travel experiences, consistently meet and exceed monthly targets for calls and qualified leads, and collaborate with the Sales team by passing high-quality opportunities for closing.

This is a goal-driven, outbound sales role where success depends on your ability to handle rejection and stay motivated, build rapport quickly over the phone, maintain strong activity levels daily, and meet weekly and monthly goals in order to achieve additional compensation through a set commission structure.

You’ll work with a wide range of educational travel programs (history, science, national parks, and more), giving you constant opportunities to connect with new prospects and refine your sales and communication skills.

Responsibilities


Make calls and leave messages for teachers nationwide and use talk tracks for live calls.
Send follow-up emails.
Work on special projects, including periodic competitive calls, calls to unassigned schools, specialty schools and other telemarketing efforts.
Periodically research schools to help identify top prospects and maintain the database. Use templates to create and send flyers and update PowerPoint presentations.


Qualifications


Desired work experience in sales, marketing, promotions or telemarketing.
Proficiency in relevant computer applications including CRM.
Desired knowledge of customer service/sales principles and practices.
Six months or more experience in sales/lead creation/lead qualifying with Telephone sales experience preferred
Good data entry/keyboard skills
Familiar with office rules/office environment

Desired knowledge of sales and marketing principles and strategies

Organized

Fun & driven environment.

description:
About the job

About Turn


Turn is a venture-backed B2B software company built for the realities of high-volume hiring. Our platform runs pre-employment background checks and continuous monitoring, and integrates directly into the systems employers already hire with — so teams in hospitality, staffing, construction, healthcare, and real estate can screen candidates fast without giving up compliance. We’re a small, fully remote team that moves quickly and ships real things.



About the Role


We’re looking for a hands-on Growth Marketing Engineer to own our full-funnel demand engine and turn the traffic and buying signals we already generate into qualified demos and pipeline.




You’ll sit at the intersection of performance marketing, marketing operations, conversion optimization, and analytics, building and running the systems that move a prospect from first touch to booked meeting. This is a builder’s role: you’ll spend your days in the ad platforms, the CRM, the analytics tools, and the page builder, shipping changes and measuring their impact on qualified-demo volume and pipeline.


What You’ll Do



Paid acquisition: Plan, launch, and optimize paid campaigns (Google Ads — Performance Max and Search, LinkedIn), architecting campaign structure, audience targeting, and conversion-event mapping so spend optimizes toward booked demos and pipeline rather than clicks, with clean, server-imported conversion tracking (enhanced/offline conversions from the CRM).


Conversion rate optimization: Build and A/B test dedicated demo landing pages, landing pages, forms, and CTAs that turn visitors into meetings, including persona-aware routing (buyer vs. candidate vs. partner) across the site, and own the on-site demo path.


Marketing operations & RevOps: Own the full lead lifecycle and the automation behind it — CRM workflows, lifecycle-stage instrumentation, lead scoring and routing, and the visitor-signal-to-outbound engine across HubSpot, Amplemarket, RB2B, Duo, and Zapier. Build and scale the loop that turns identified in-market website visitors into timely, signal-based 1:1 outreach.


Email deliverability & infrastructure: Own outbound sending infrastructure — mailbox and domain strategy, warm-up and rotation, pre-send verification, and deliverability health — so outreach lands in the inbox and protects the primary domain’s reputation.


Analytics & reporting: Build and own the measurement layer end to end — define the key conversion events, GA4, UTM governance, conversion validation — and build the dashboards that tie marketing activity to pipeline and revenue (Mode).


Conversion copywriting: Write the ad, landing-page, and signal-based outbound copy that drives response.



What You’ll Need



Hands-on experience across growth marketing, demand generation, marketing operations, or revenue operations — ideally in B2B SaaS. You’re a builder who works inside the tools, not only a strategist.


Real performance-marketing experience, especially Google Ads (including Performance Max and Search campaign structure), with a habit of optimizing toward CAC and pipeline instead of vanity metrics.


Fluency with a modern marketing / CRM automation stack (we use HubSpot, Amplemarket, RB2B, Intercom, Zapier, and Calendly; comparable tools like Salesforce, Marketo, or Make are fine).


Analytics chops: GA4, disciplined UTM and conversion tracking, and enough SQL / BI to build your own dashboards (we use Mode; Looker, Amplitude, or similar is fine).


CRO instincts and conversion copywriting ability.


A data-driven, experimental, self-directed way of working — you read the funnel, ship the fix, and measure the result.


Bilingual Spanish/English, with fluent written English.





This is our ideal profile, not a checklist. If you can do the work, we’d love to hear from you regardless of years or title.


Success Metrics (First 6–12 Months)



Growth in qualified demos and marketing-sourced pipeline, at flat or lower cost per acquisition.


Higher conversion rates across the funnel, from visitor to demo to booked meeting.


A larger share of best-fit (ICP) traffic reached and converted.


Strong outbound deliverability and healthy sending infrastructure across all domains.


A reliable weekly reporting cadence that ties marketing activity to pipeline.



Nice to Have



Experience in HR tech, workforce, background screening, or compliance-adjacent categories.


Account-based marketing (ABM) and audience segmentation.


Server-side, enhanced, or offline conversion tracking (e.g. CAPI).


Outbound email deliverability at scale — multi-domain/mailbox management, warm-up, and inbox placement.


Technical SEO and simple creative for ads and social.



Perks & Compensation

Carreras con cuidado integrado: descubre nuestros beneficios aquí

Ferrero comenzó su trayectoria en la pequeña ciudad de Alba en Piamonte, Italia, en 1946. Hoy en día, es una de las empresas de alimentos  dulces envasados más grandes del mundo, con muchas marcas icónicas  que se venden en todo el mundo. Descubre más sobre Ferrero en ferrero.com

About the job

Company Introduction

WorldStrides is the global leader in educational travel and experiential learning. The company was founded in 1967 to provide middle school travel programs to Washington, D.C. and has grown to provide a wide range of programs for more than half a million students annually to over 100 countries around the world. WorldStrides offers experiential learning programs in educational travel, performing arts, language immersion, career exploration, service-learning, study abroad, and sports. Each of these experiences helps students to see beyond the classroom and to see the world – and themselves – in new ways.

Job Description

The Business Development Representative (BDR) / Lead Qualifier is responsible for generating new business opportunities through high-volume outbound calls and email outreach to schools and teachers across the U.S.

In this role, you will: Proactively prospect and engage educators to introduce WorldStrides programs, qualify leads by identifying teachers interested in organizing student travel experiences, consistently meet and exceed monthly targets for calls and qualified leads, and collaborate with the Sales team by passing high-quality opportunities for closing.

This is a goal-driven, outbound sales role where success depends on your ability to handle rejection and stay motivated, build rapport quickly over the phone, maintain strong activity levels daily, and meet weekly and monthly goals in order to achieve additional compensation through a set commission structure.

You’ll work with a wide range of educational travel programs (history, science, national parks, and more), giving you constant opportunities to connect with new prospects and refine your sales and communication skills.

Make calls and leave messages for teachers nationwide and use talk tracks for live calls.

title: Talent Operations Manager
description:
About the job

Job Title: Talent Operations Manager




Job Type: Full-time




Location: Remote




The Role

Scale the human data engine behind frontier AI systems. Own onboarding, talent coordination, and client success across high-velocity AI training deployments. Operate at the intersection of contributors, internal teams, and enterprise clients — keeping projects moving and making sure the right people are activated at the right time.




This is a hands-on operations role, not a traditional people-management role. You’ll coordinate large groups of contributors across teams rather than manage a team of direct reports.




You’ll have real ownership, work closely with teams across the company, and see the impact of your work directly in the AI systems our customers are building.




What You’ll Own

Run large-cohort onboarding and activation — fast, organized, and with a strong contributor experience.

Coordinate distributed talent pools across multiple AI training and data operations projects.

Work closely with enterprise clients and internal teams to keep deployments on track.

Anticipate blockers before they surface and drive them to resolution.

Track project performance and publish clear weekly updates on milestones, risks, and outcomes.

Run community syncs and engagement initiatives that keep contributors informed and engaged.

Partner with product, engineering, and other teams as model and client needs change.

Use data to improve onboarding, quality, and retention over time.




What We're Looking For

Strong written communicator. Clear, structured, and direct.

Highly organized and comfortable coordinating a lot of moving pieces.

Proactive — you spot gaps, follow through, and don’t wait for someone else to solve the problem.

Comfortable working with data, dashboards, and KPIs.

Able to move quickly when priorities or requirements change.

You don’t need extensive management experience for this role. We’re looking for someone who is great at coordination and execution, not someone whose strength is managing a large team of direct reports.




Preferred

Experience in human data, AI training, data operations, talent operations, or working with technical clients is a plus, but not required.




Compensation & Benefits Notice

The national pay range for this full-time position is base salary of $50,000 –$70,000 USD. All employees are eligible for equity compensation, and employees may also receive performance-based bonuses, dependent on role and subject to company policies. micro1 provides a comprehensive benefits package, including up to 100% reimbursement for health-insurance premiums, paid time off, a 401(K) plan with a company match, and additional benefits designed to support a high-performing, remote-first workforce.

description:
About the job

About The Team

The Touring Buyer Experience (TBEX) team owns the end-to-end touring experience across web, iOS, and Android. We work as a cross-platform product engineering team with shared ownership of the customer experience, partnering across functions to build seamless, measurable experiences that help more customers move confidently through their home-buying journey. We are also deeply AI-forward in how we build with standard AI-assisted coding across the team, shipping across all parts of the stack with on-call and cross-stack ownership.

About The Role

This is not a standard Senior Software Development Engineer role. We’re looking for a mobile product builder who can take an ambiguous idea and turn it into a shipped, instrumented, and continuously improving customer experience. In this role, you’ll partner closely with product, design, and engineering peers to shape solutions, build across mobile and supporting services when needed, and use AI-assisted tools as part of day-to-day development while remaining accountable for quality, correctness, customer experience, and results.

This role has been categorized as a teleworker position. Teleworkers do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and instead work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. Employees may live anywhere in Mexico, with availability to travel to Mexico City, as we recommend attendance at occasional office events.

In addition to a competitive base salary and benefits, this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location.

Who you are


You have significant experience building and shipping production mobile applications on iOS and/or Android. 
You are comfortable working across the stack, including mobile clients, APIs, services, and data considerations, when needed to deliver outcomes. 
You have experience supporting production systems, participating in on-call rotations, and using observability and operational signals to guide improvements. 
You have a track record of owning features end to end, from ambiguous problem definition through launch and post-launch iteration. 
You bring strong technical, product, and business judgment, and can connect engineering decisions to customer and company impact. 
You collaborate effectively with cross-functional partners and communicate clearly in writing and verbally, including in asynchronous environments. 
You have depth in one mobile platform and working familiarity with the other, with the ability to reason about cross-platform experiences and backend-connected issues. 
You are comfortable using AI-assisted development tools in day-to-day work while maintaining accountability for quality, correctness, and customer experience. 
Here at Zillow - we value the experience and perspective of candidates with non-traditional backgrounds. We encourage you to apply if you have transferable skills or related experiences. 


Get to know us

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company that's reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.

How we work is a key part of that transformation. Through Cloud HQ, our strategic approach to distributed work, most employees have the flexibility to work from wherever they’re most productive—enabling us to move fast, stay connected and deliver on our people promise.

Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S.. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME’s America’s Best Companies 2026 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.

No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.

Zillow Group is committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment and to providing equal employment opportunities. We comply with applicable laws that prohibit discrimination in employment and recruitment.

If you have a disability or special need that requires reasonable accommodation during the recruitment process, please contact your recruiter directly.

Qualified applicants will be considered for employment based on their qualifications and ability to perform the functions of the position, without discrimination and in accordance with applicable law.

Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. Pursuant to the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

title: GTM Strategy Analyst

Owner analítico del funnel completo: NQL→SQL→Enrolamiento→Aprobación→Activación→Retención. Diagnosticar dónde se pierde valor, cuantificar el tamaño de cada oportunidad y mantener un Control Tower con CAC, payback, LTV y Gross Profit por canal, levantando alertas cuando algo se desvía de la tesis

Resolución de problemas estratégicos (tu día a día estilo consultoría): estructurar problemas ambiguos en análisis accionables — descomponer una caída de ventas en tasa × ticket × volumen, diagnosticar un funnel SDR, dimensionar un canal nuevo con un business case
Pricing & elegibilidad (con Riesgo): modelar bandas de precio/score-cut y diseñar/leer experimentos A/B que equilibren aprobación y margen
Research de cliente: entrevistas, jobs-to-be-done e insights de mercado que se traducen en ofertas, mensajes y apuestas de segmento

De la recomendación a la ejecución: bajar la estrategia a instrumentos operables — playbooks de Outbound, lead scoring, territories, listas activables (AI/enrichment), briefs de Digital — y coordinar handoffs con SDR/AE, Marketing y Growth
Cadencia operativa: preparar y facilitar WBR/MBR. No reportas métricas: cuentas la historia del negocio, propones la decisión y das seguimiento a los compromisos

Experimentación y gobierno de datos: priorizar hipótesis, diseñar tests, instrumentar tracking, productizar ganadores (playbook + métricas); definir eventos, taxonomías y QA de tracking con Analytics/Eng
Pensamiento estructurado: descompones problemas ambiguos en árboles de hipótesis, priorizas el análisis que mueve la decisión y comunicas con claridad ejecutiva (escrita y verbal)
Estratega operador(a): la recomendación no te basta; bajas la idea a dashboard, playbook y piloto en días, no semanas
Data chops: SQL intermedio-avanzado, manejo de BigQuery/Looker o equivalentes; familiaridad con causalidad/experimentos y métricas de funnel
AI driven: experto en Claude/Chat GPT/Gemini/otros, con casos de uso claros y con impacto
Track record de impacto en KPIs: has movido números concretos — enrolamientos, aprobación, activación, churn — y puedes contar el cómo, no solo el cuánto
Obsesión por el cliente: research continuo, entrevistas, jobs-to-be-done, y capacidad de transformar insights en ofertas y mensajes accionables

Owner mindset: foco en impacto económico (CAC, payback, margen, LTV), no en entregables
2+ años en consultoría estratégica o roles GTM/Strategy/Growth/RevOps analíticos, ideal con foco en adquisición B2B (fintech, SaaS, pagos o lending es plus)
Experiencia probada gestionando funnel completo y mejorando KPIs (enrolamientos, aprobación, activación, churn)
SQL (intermedio a avanzado) y Excel/Sheets avanzado

 Prolific

Prolific is not just another player in the AI space – we are the architects of the human data infrastructure that's reshaping the landscape of AI development. In a world where foundational AI technologies are increasingly commoditized, it's the quality and diversity of human-generated data that truly differentiates products and models.

Background in executing innovative, high-volume sourcing strategies, delivering scalable pipelines of top-tier candidates.
Builder mindset with a passion for innovation, designing and scaling sourcing and hiring solutions that continuously elevate speed to onboard and operational efficiency.

Experience with global crowdsourcing or gig-economy platforms, which would add significant value.

Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

You're going to fix that.

The opportunity

We’re seeking a chronically online, Social Media Lead to drive Kraken Pro social channels. At Kraken, understanding our brand ethos, mission, and the communities we serve is essential and social is at the forefront of that.

Student Onboarding & Pipeline Administration

RevOps Data, Feedback Loops & Process Optimization

skills: Cumplir los objetivos de ingresos (Revenue/Rev) y margen bruto (GM%) por línea de producto (PL) en cada cuenta asignada.

Adopción de múltiples productos y creación y entrega de propuestas de valor integradas entre diferentes líneas de producto (PL).
Precisión en los pronósticos.
Gestión disciplinada del CRM.

La responsabilidad sobre el ciclo de vida completo del proceso de Gestión de Cuentas, de principio a fin, así como la iniciativa para cumplir con sus responsabilidades, recae en última instancia en usted.

Responsable del Plan de Cuenta en SFDC (Salesforce), incluyendo la comunicación del plan a todas las partes interesadas, la planificación de recursos y actividades necesarias para alcanzar el desempeño anual establecido en el plan.
Adoptar e impulsar el uso consistente y efectivo de las herramientas tecnológicas (SFDC, XAIT-Porter).

Supervisar el proceso de desarrollo y respuesta a licitaciones, garantizando que todos los recursos necesarios estén disponibles para presentar propuestas de la más alta calidad a través del proceso de gestión de licitaciones.
Responsable de abordar las consideraciones presupuestarias de las propuestas, así como de tratar las especificaciones técnicas con el cliente en conjunto con el equipo de ventas técnicas.

En coordinación con Ventas Técnicas y el Vicepresidente/Director de Ventas, responsable de las negociaciones, incluidas las extensiones contractuales, asegurando que SFDC se mantenga actualizado y actuando como enlace con el área legal cuando sea necesario para la redacción de contratos.
Recopilar y difundir inteligencia de mercado, incluyendo la obtención de retroalimentación de los clientes.

Desarrollar y ejecutar planes estratégicos para fortalecer la identidad de WFT, comprendiendo los objetivos y desafíos clave de los clientes y de la industria, enfatizando y alineando nuestras capacidades fundamentales ( Core Capabilities ).
Supervisar todas las áreas de riesgo del negocio y garantizar la existencia de estrategias que mitiguen dichos riesgos en la mayor medida posible.

Una vez que el cliente comunique los resultados del proceso de licitación, será responsable de coordinar una reunión de retroalimentación ( debrief ) en caso de pérdida, o de informar a las partes interesadas clave en caso de adjudicación, incluyendo la actualización correspondiente en SFDC.
Responsable de coordinar y facilitar una reunión de traspaso de contrato con las partes interesadas clave y de generar un resumen ejecutivo del contrato.
Responsable de revisar el desempeño de los contratos y garantizar que todos los asuntos relevantes sean elevados a la dirección para su seguimiento y toma de decisiones.
Ingenieria o Licenciatura completada
10 años de experiencia en la industria, incluyendo un mínimo de 3 años en ventas dentro del sector, experiencia previa en operaciones de campo (cualquier PL)
Ingles: Avanzado (que sea capaz de comunicarse en ese idioma)
Licitaciones (tenders)
Contratos
Negociaciones
Maximización de márgenes y rentabilidad

Excelentes habilidades para la gestión y desarrollo de relaciones con clientes.
Suficiente visión de negocio para evaluar oportunidades y establecer prioridades de manera efectiva.
Capacidad para trabajar en equipo, con excelentes habilidades de comunicación verbal y escrita.
Habilidad para gestionar múltiples proyectos simultáneamente bajo plazos ajustados, manteniendo la calma y el desempeño bajo presión.
Conocimiento y familiaridad con las últimas tendencias y metodologías en gestión de ventas.

title: Loyalty Manager
description:
About the job

Bullfinch Recruitment are proud to be partnering with a high-growth social gaming business, delivering innovative, scalable products to a global player base, who are looking for a Loyalty Manager to join their team.




What you'll do: 

● Proactive Outreach: Drive revenue and retention by conducting regular outbound calls to

your portfolio of top-tier players, identifying opportunities to deepen engagement and present

tailored offers that convert.

● Relationship Management: Act as the primary advocate and concierge for your players,

building the trust and rapport that makes every sales conversation feel natural rather than

transactional.

● Bespoke Offer Creation: Use your knowledge of player preferences and play patterns to

design and pitch unique, tailored rewards and incentives, treating every offer as a sales

opportunity to increase player value and loyalty.

● Needs-Based Selling: Proactively identify what each player needs, whether that's

reassurance, a specific reward, or a resolution and address it directly, turning every interaction

into a chance to strengthen the relationship and drive results.

● Query Resolution: Draw on strong customer service instincts to act as the subject matter

expert for player inquiries regarding rewards, loyalty programs, and account benefits, resolving

issues swiftly so trust stays intact and the door stays open for the next offer.

● Player Requests: Monitor and facilitate withdrawal requests for your players, ensuring a

smooth, prioritized experience that reinforces confidence in the relationship.

● Player Advocacy: Collaborate with internal teams to ensure player feedback is heard and

their needs are met across all touchpoints feeding insights back into future offer strategy.

What we're looking for

● Sales Mindset: A natural at spotting opportunities in conversation and confidently guiding

players toward offers that genuinely benefit them, comfortable with outbound calling as a core

part of the role.

● Customer Service Background: Prior experience in a CS or player-facing support roles, with

a demonstrated ability to attend to player needs, resolve issues empathetically, and turn

problems into positive outcomes.

● Interpersonal Excellence: Fluent in English, able to communicate with confidence, empathy,

and persuasion over the phone and via written channels.

● Accountability: You take pride in owning a problem and an opportunity from start to finish.

Reliable, and you follow through on every promise made to a player.

● Discretion & Judgment: Ability to make informed decisions on custom rewards and player

requests within company guidelines, balancing player satisfaction with commercial impact.

Through PayJoy’s point-of-sale financing and card offerings, customers gain access to a modern quality of life. title: Regenerative Medicine Doctor
description:
About the job

Regenerative Medicine Doctor 

Long Term Position Puerto Vallarta Mexico Advanced Integrative and Regenerative Medicine Clinic

Holistic Bio Spa® is seeking an exceptional Regenerative Medicine Doctor to join our clinical team in Puerto Vallarta, Mexico.

This is a long-term, on-site position for a serious, bilingual physician who is fully licensed to practice medicine in Mexico and genuinely passionate about regenerative, functional, integrative, and holistic medicine.

We are looking for a doctor who wants to help patients worldwide access personalized Medicine 4.0® care in a respected regenerative medicine clinic.

About Holistic Bio Spa®

Holistic Bio Spa® is an advanced integrative and regenerative medicine clinic in Puerto Vallarta, Jalisco, Mexico.

For more than 21 years, Holistic Bio Spa® has served patients seeking medicine that looks beyond symptoms and supports repair, regeneration, detoxification, balance, and healing.

Our patients travel worldwide for personalized regenerative, functional, cellular, IV, oxygen, ozone, peptide, hormone, detoxification, nutrition, and long-term health protocols.

Our clinical philosophy is built around Medicine 4.0®, a personalized, systems-based approach focused on:

· Cellular repair, regeneration, and mitochondrial optimization

· Immune modulation, hormone balance, and detoxification

· Neurorepair, gut health, inflammation reduction, and longevity

· Personalized education and long-term follow-up

We work with complex patients, wellness patients, high-performance individuals, and people frustrated with conventional medical models.

The Opportunity

The Regenerative Medicine Doctor will work directly with patients and our clinical team to design, supervise, and refine personalized Medicine 4.0® protocols.

This role requires medical intelligence, communication, humility, curiosity, and patient-centered care. The doctor must be comfortable with international patients who expect clarity, professionalism, compassion, and high-level clinical thinking.

This is a stable, long-term position for a physician who wants to live in Puerto Vallarta and help shape regenerative medicine in Mexico.

Required Qualifications

Candidates must meet the following requirements:

· Medical degree with valid credentials to practice medicine in Mexico.

· Current Mexican professional license/cedula professional.

· SEP-recognized medical credentials.

· SEP-recognized diplomado, master's degree, specialty, or equivalent credential in regenerative, functional, integrative, anti-aging, or related medicine.

· Fluent in English and Spanish.

· Bicultural experience strongly preferred.

· Minimum 3-5 years of hands-on experience in integrative, functional, regenerative, anti-aging, oncology-support, Lyme, autoimmune, hormone, or complex illness care.

· Willingness to work on-site in Puerto Vallarta.

· Long-term commitment and desire to grow with the clinic.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is:

· A physician who truly loves regenerative medicine.

· Serious, responsible, ethical, and clinically careful.

· Warm, confident, and able to explain complex concepts clearly.

· Comfortable working with patients from different cultures and countries.

· Curious, committed to learning, and open to advanced therapies while respecting safety, documentation, and patient-specific judgment.

· Strong in follow-through, communication, and teamwork.

· Interested in Medicine 4.0®, cellular repair, root-cause medicine, and long-term patient transformation.

This doctor should not depend on a conventional symptom-suppression mindset. Our focus is terrain, repair, inflammation reduction, immune function, hormone optimization, mitochondrial energy, and quality of life.

Clinical Areas Of Focus

Experience or strong interest in the following areas is highly valuable:

· Stem cell, cellular, and immune therapies, including MUSE Cells®, MSCs, exosomes, secretomes, PRP, NK cells, dendritic cells, and immune modulation.

· Ozone, oxygen, peptide, and red light therapies, including 10-pass ozone, HBOT, EWOT, and regenerative, immune, neurological, metabolic, and longevity peptides.

· Hormone replacement and optimization, including BHRT, pellets, thyroid, adrenal, testosterone, estrogen, progesterone, DHEA, and related strategies.

· Nutrigenomics, DNA interpretation, methylation, detox pathways, supplement planning, and advanced lab interpretation.

· Lyme disease, mold illness, autoimmune disease, chronic inflammation, chronic fatigue, long COVID, neurological decline, and complex chronic illness.




The Regenerative Medicine Doctor will:

· Perform comprehensive medical evaluations before treatment.

· Review histories, labs, medications, supplements, goals, and contraindications.

· Co-create personalized, tiered Medicine 4.0® protocols.

· Supervise regenerative, IV, hormonal, peptide, detox, and advanced wellness therapies.

· Interpret advanced labs, hormone and metabolic panels, 3D Scan findings, and patient progress data.

· Coordinate with nurses, therapists, reception, administration, and patient-care staff.

· Provide clear patient education in English and Spanish.

· Support clinical decisions before, during, and after visits.

· Help refine protocols, workflows, patient education, and team training.

Important Clinical Fit

Holistic Bio Spa® is a regenerative, integrative, and holistic medical clinic.

We are not a chemotherapy-centered practice. We work with cancer-support patients, but our model is integrative, regenerative, immune-supportive, mitochondrial, terrain-based, and patient-centered.

We are also not an antibiotic-centered clinic. Antibiotics may be used when clinically necessary, but our foundation is immune modulation, detoxification, gut health, cellular therapies, hormones, peptides, supplementation, and regenerative repair.

The right doctor must understand and respect this philosophy.

Nutrition And Supplement Knowledge

Nutritional supplementation is an important part of our Medicine 4.0® approach.

Holistic Bio Spa® uses physician-supervised supplements for inflammation, mitochondrial function, detoxification, hormone balance, gut repair, immune support, sleep, neurorepair, longevity, and performance.

The ideal doctor should be comfortable evaluating supplement protocols, contraindications, interactions, and high-quality supplements as part of a larger clinical plan.

Compensation And Growth

Holistic Bio Spa® offers a highly competitive compensation structure based on experience, clinical skill, professionalism, results, and long-term commitment.

The position includes strong earning potential, including performance and commission opportunities for the right candidate.

We reward expertise, patient care, teamwork, learning, and clinical excellence. A doctor who grows with the clinic will have room to build a strong future here.

What We Offer

· Highly competitive compensation and strong performance opportunity.

· Long-term, stable position in Puerto Vallarta.

· International patient base.

· Ongoing training in advanced regenerative therapies.

· A clinic with more than 300 treatments and a broad Medicine 4.0® framework.

· Exposure to therapies such as DEZAWA MUSE Cells®, peptides, HRT, HBOT, EWOT, HOCATT®, neuroregeneration, FMT, NK cells, exosomes, KLOTHO, dendritic cells, secretomes, photobiomodulation, PEMF, NAD, 10-pass ozone, epigenetics, DNA/lab testing, plasmapheresis, IV nutrition, Holistic 10X Health System®, hydrogen breathing, shockwave, FIR sauna, biohacking, Lyme support, mitochondrial support, and related therapies.

· A professional clinical environment with a mission-driven team.

· The opportunity to help shape regenerative medicine in Mexico.

Who Should Apply

You should apply if:

· You are licensed to practice medicine in Mexico.

· You have the required SEP-recognized credentials in Regenerative Medicine.

· You are bilingual in English and Spanish.

· You love regenerative medicine and want to keep learning.

· You want a long-term, serious role, not a temporary stop.

· You are comfortable working with international patients.

· You care about patient dignity, safety, communication, and measurable progress.

· You want to help build the next generation of medicine.

Who Should Not Apply

This role is not a good fit for someone who:

· Does not have valid authorization to practice medicine in Mexico.

· Does not have recognized training or credentials in regenerative, integrative, functional, anti-aging, or related medicine.

· Is not fluent in English and Spanish.

· Wants only a short-term position.

· Is uncomfortable with holistic, functional, regenerative, or biologically based medicine.

· Is unwilling to learn new therapies and systems.

· Does not enjoy patient education, teamwork, and international patient care.

Location

Holistic Bio Spa® is located in Puerto Vallarta, Jalisco Mexico.

Puerto Vallarta offers ocean, mountains, culture, international community, and a growing wellness environment. This is ideal for a doctor who wants a meaningful clinical career in one of Mexico's most beautiful coastal destinations.

How To Apply

Please send:

· Your CV or resume.

· A brief cover letter explaining your experience in regenerative, functional, integrative, or anti-aging medicine.

· Confirmation of your current license to practice medicine in Mexico.

· Information about your SEP-recognized regenerative, functional, integrative, anti-aging, or related credential.

· Your English and Spanish fluency level.

· Why you believe you would be a strong long-term fit for Holistic Bio Spa®.

Email: zoli@holisticbiospa.com

Website: www.HolisticBioSpa.com

Holistic Bio Spa®

Practicing the Medicine of the Future... Today!®

About the job

WeWork Reforma Latino (97001), Mexico, Ciudad de Mexico, Ciudad de Mexico

Lead Site Reliability Engineer

We're building a Site Reliability Engineering center in Mexico City, and we're hiring a Manager-level Backend Engineer to own the reliability and operational maturity of our settlement platforms. These are batch-critical systems that process every credit and debit transaction across the network.

This is a foundational role. You'll be one of the first engineers in CDMX responsible for ensuring settlement cycles complete accurately, on time, and in compliance with SOX and PCI-DSS requirements. You'll work across hybrid infrastructure (on-prem data centers and AWS), partner closely with UK-based engineers, and build the automation and observability that allows Mexico City to operate settlement.

What You'll Do


Own reliability for batch settlement systems - ensure cycle completion windows are met, data integrity is maintained, and failures are detected before they reach downstream consumers
Build and improve observability for settlement pipelines - dashboards, alerts, and anomaly detection that make system health legible and reduce reliance on tribal knowledge
Drive automation of operational toil - certificate rotation, environment provisioning, compliance artifact generation, and manual validation steps that currently require human intervention
Partner with UK-based settlement engineers - acquire domain expertise on Durbin compliance windows, cross-border DCI routing, and acquirer/issuer SLA adherence

At least two manual settlement operations processes fully automated

Documented runbooks and severity criteria for all critical settlement failure modes

You'll work with batch processing systems that handle financial transactions across multiple on-prem data centers with active/active and active/passive configurations. The stack includes Java, Python, shell scripting, SQL, AWS, Kubernetes, OpenShift containers, Datadog, Observe, and legacy payment platforms. CI/CD pipelines, API automation, and secret management via HashiCorp Vault are part of daily operations. You'll leverage agentic AI automation (Claude Code or others) to accelerate development and build automation solutions. You'll need strong troubleshooting and debugging skills and be comfortable with both modern cloud-native tooling and traditional enterprise batch systems.

Professional English fluency
Bachelor's degree

3+ years of experience with container orchestration services including Docker or Kubernetes
Experience with Shell or Bash scripting
At least 3 years of Unix or Linux system administration experience


Preferred Qualifications


Experience developing automation solutions using agentic AI tools (Claude Code, Copilot CLI)
Troubleshooting and debugging skills across distributed systems
Familiarity with payments, financial services, or other regulated high-availability domains
Knowledge or experience of Networking concepts (TCP/DNS/TLS)

description:
About the job

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role: 

We are seeking a talented and motivated Chargeback Operations Analyst who is best in class with a high IQ plus a high EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.

As a Chargeback Analyst, you will be responsible for analyzing and responding to card and ACH disputes filed against Sezzle. Working closely with our fraud/risk team and our customer disputes team, you will navigate issues on a case by case basis to determine the best course of action to help our customers get unstuck. Analysts will also make recommendations to our Chargeback Manager on how to improve and scale our processes. We are looking for a teammate who can work full-time Monday through Friday between 9:00 am - 5:30 pm CST.

Due to the requirements of the position, only English resumes will be accepted.

What You'll Do:


Investigate disputed credit card, debit card, and ACH transactions and take suitable action to resolve those disputes within the allowed timeframes.
Work cross functionally with relevant departments (fraud, disputes) to determine next steps on a case to case basis. 
Investigate individual transactions using internal policies and review methodologies to identify patterns or trends.
Understand our systems and tools; investigate account patterns through data analysis. 
Collaborate with analysts, operations specialists, data scientists and engineering to improve our loss prevention mechanisms, processes and tools. 
Learn and maintain strong domain knowledge of the world of fraud including prevention techniques and technologies. 
Maintain or exceed established service level agreements (SLAs) for timely resolution of queued cases to minimize potential losses. 
Handle escalations from internal and external stakeholders in a professional and efficient manner.


What We Look For:


Bachelor's degree from an accredited institution 
Minimum 1 year of experience in processing chargebacks or investigating and resolving fraud incidents 
Experienced in analyzing data and comfortable making impactful decisions in a fast-paced and sometimes ambiguous environment 
Attention to detail and ability to multitask 
Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills 
Strong business judgment and communication skills 
Ability to self-start and work with minimal supervision after training 
Able to work through holidays 


Preferred Qualifications


2+ years of experience in processing chargebacks or fraud claims or live transactions against fraudulent activity in e-commerce, banking, fintech or financial institutions is a plus
Ideal candidate will be available to start within two weeks following an offer 


About You:


You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.


What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome:

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.
